simple.meaning: חֲתַם (chătham) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to seal.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 6:18. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲתַם (H2857) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
